subtitleNullable: Submission files, predictions, ensembles, and experiments for Kaggle competition
descriptionNullable:
This dataset contains my submission files from Kaggle competitions completed during the month. I'm publishing them so others can use them for research, benchmarking, ensembling, model comparison, or as additional inputs for their own machine learning workflows.

Each submission represents a different experiment and may come from different models, feature engineering approaches, hyperparameter settings, or ensemble strategies. The files are provided as-is to encourage experimentation and collaboration within the Kaggle community.

Feel free to use these submissions to build ensembles, analyze prediction diversity, compare approaches, or improve your own models. If you find this dataset useful, an upvote is always appreciated.
